metadata.label: Imports and exports of goods by commodity groups SPIN 2002 and trading partner, not adjusted for non response. Month 1999M01-2008M12
note: Data on export, import and net trade are revised continuously every month for the last three months.

Values are shown in thousands of Swedish krona (SEK) in current prices if nothing else is stated. Weights are shown in metric tons, for some goods other quantities are shown such as cubic meters or pieces. Secrecy in the database is marked with … For foreign trade with services see Balance of Payments (BoP) in subject area Financial Markets (www.scb.se/FM0001-En).

Companies that import and export below a certain threshold within the EU are not obligated to report their trade statistics. These values and values for companies that have not responded are adjusted when adjusted for non-response is stated. Weight is also adjusted in the same way. Data that is not adjusted is based purely on collected values. These values are therefore underestimated.

SPIN2002.label: products by SPIN 2002
note: SPIN 2002 is Statistics Sweden´s classification of goods. The goods are grouped according to the Swedish industrial classification, SIC 2002 (also called SNI). On four-digit level SPIN corresponds to Eurostat´s CPA (Classification of Product by Activity). SPIN is not the same as SIC. While SIC is a classification of enterprises into industries SPIN is a classification of goods into industries. Foreign trade for a certain SPIN-code is therefore not the same as foreign trade for companies with the corresponding SIC-code.  Prod-SNI97 and Varu-SNI69 are predecessors to SPIN corresponding to SIC 92 and SIC 69.

29.60: Statistics in commodity group Arms and Ammunition (SITC 891, SPIN 29.6, 29.60 and 29.600) must be interpreted with care. It is not to be used as an estimate on Swedish trade in goods for military and defence use. Included in the commodity group are both arms and ammunition for civilian as military use. Not included in the commodity group are Aircrafts, ships, vehicles, search- and measuring systems etc. for military use. The commodity group therefore consists of only a small amount in what is considered as goods for military and defence use. Complete statistics on goods for military and defence use is provided by Swedish Agency for Non-proliferation and Export controls (ISP).
